title: Database out of memory
reason: The diagnosis correctly points to the DB as the failing component, identifies the memory/OOM problem, and attributes it to the new API 2.4.0 sales‑report query.
root_cause: The new sales‑report feature (api 2.4.0) executes a heavy multi‑join query that pushes PostgreSQL memory usage to the container’s 1 GiB limit, triggering the OOM killer and repeatedly crashing the DB container.
truth: api 2.4.0 added a sales report query that makes PostgreSQL use more than its 1 GB memory limit, so it is killed (out of memory, signal 9) and keeps restarting.
